response.sql: WITH overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(s.modindex) as overall_avg_modindex FROM signals s JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE s.modindex IS NOT NULL AND s.phaseshiftdeg IS NOT NULL), telescope_weather_groups AS (SELECT t.telescregistry, o.weathprofile, AVG(s.modindex) as avg_modindex, AVG(s.phaseshiftdeg) as avg_phaseshiftdeg FROM signals s JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE s.modindex IS NOT NULL AND s.phaseshiftdeg IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.telescregistry, o.weathprofile), filtered_groups AS (SELECT twg.telescregistry, twg.weathprofile, twg.avg_modindex, twg.avg_phaseshiftdeg FROM telescope_weather_groups twg CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE twg.avg_modindex > oa.overall_avg_modindex) SELECT fg.weathprofile, AVG(fg.avg_modindex) as avg_modindex_of_groups, AVG(fg.avg_phaseshiftdeg) as avg_phaseshiftdeg_of_groups, AVG(fg.avg_modindex) - (SELECT overall_avg_modindex FROM overall_avg) as above_overall_average FROM filtered_groups fg GROUP BY fg.weathprofile ORDER BY fg.weathprofile
